explication: Liquid Glass (Backdrop) is a Compose Multiplatform library for drawing customizable backdrop effects; the catalog app demonstrates those APIs with interactive glass UI examples. The principal workflow is a Compose screen applying a backdrop modifier, which draws a backdrop layer and applies configured effects and surface treatments. The graph also shows the catalog’s navigation and example components. Some subsystems are represented by their exact source directories because their individual implementations were not sampled; links are limited to README or SOURCE INDEX evidence.
